description: Ib Troen and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The archive reproduces the data disk accompanying the European Wind Atlas. It contains regionally representative wind statistics and wind-speed histograms for stations in the twelve listed European Community countries, with radiosonde statistics in a separate directory. LIB and TAB files are sequential ASCII representations described in the atlas appendix. This historical collection is distinct from the later New European Wind Atlas. It supports wind-resource and site-assessment inputs within the original station network, without implying present-day climatology, complete continental coverage or compatibility with every modern modelling package. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
